name: agent-ops
description: A provider-neutral, policy-governed operating architecture for bounded coding-agent work.

scripts.check:roadmap-adapter: node --test tools/roadmap-adapter.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @agent-ops/contracts test && pnpm --filter @agent-ops/adapters test
scripts.check:print-provider: node --test tools/print-provider.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @agent-ops/provider-sdk test && pnpm --filter @agent-ops/provider-print test
scripts.db:lint: supabase db lint --local --schema agentops,agentops_audit,agentops_private --level warning --fail-on error
scripts.validate: pnpm run check:specs && pnpm run check:traceability && pnpm run check:governance && pnpm run check:service-packaging && pnpm run check:roadmap-adapter && pnpm run check:print-provider && pnpm run check:supabase && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run roadmap:validate
